loginType.title: Login Type
loginType.description: Authenticate with a ThinQ account (username/password) or a pre-issued refresh token.

country.title: Country
country.description: ThinQ account country code (e.g. US, KR, GB).

refreshIntervalSeconds.title: Refresh Interval
refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Device state refresh interval in seconds.

filterMonitoringIntervalSeconds.title: Filter Monitoring Interval
filterMonitoringIntervalSeconds.description: Filter life state refresh interval in seconds (low frequency, filter life changes over days/weeks).

username.title: ThinQ Account Username
username.description: Email address or phone number used to sign in to LG ThinQ.

password.title: ThinQ Account Password
password.description: Password for your LG ThinQ account.

devices.title: ThinQ Devices
devices.description: Auto-populated on discovery. Per-device capability flags gate which Matter features are advertised.

productName.title: Product Name Override
productName.description: Override the Matter product name shown for this device. Only applied when Override Matter Configuration is enabled in Advanced Features.

productId.title: Product ID Override
productId.description: Override the Matter product id shown for this device. Only applied when Override Matter Configuration is enabled in Advanced Features.

supportsHeat.title: Supports Heat
supportsHeat.description: Whether this device supports heating mode.

supportsFanSpeedControl.title: Supports Fan Speed Control
supportsFanSpeedControl.description: Whether this device supports adjustable fan speed.

supportsSwingMode.title: Supports Swing Mode
supportsSwingMode.description: Whether this device supports swing mode (vertical/horizontal vane control).

supportsHumiditySensor.title: Supports Humidity Sensor
supportsHumiditySensor.description: Whether this device reports humidity data.

supportsAirQualitySensor.title: Supports Air-Quality Sensor
supportsAirQualitySensor.description: Whether this device reports air-quality (AQI, PM2.5, PM10) data.

supportsEnergyMonitoring.title: Supports Energy Monitoring
supportsEnergyMonitoring.description: Whether this device reports instantaneous power consumption data.

supportsFilterMonitoring.title: Supports Filter Monitoring
supportsFilterMonitoring.description: Whether this device reports air-filter life/remaining-percent data.

allowRemoteStop.title: Allow Remote Stop (Washer)
allowRemoteStop.description: Turning this on lets Apple Home send a real stop/cancel command to the physical washer. Off by default.

allowRemoteStart.title: Allow Remote Start (Washer)
allowRemoteStart.description: Turning this on lets Apple Home send a real Start command to the physical washer, using the washer's own model-declared default wash course. This is materially higher risk than Stop (it can start a wash cycle with water/detergent/power). Off by default — enable only when you are ready to verify it yourself.

selectedCourse.title: Selected Wash Course
selectedCourse.description: The wash course used when Remote Start is triggered. Auto-filled with the washer's own default course on first discovery. Type the exact Course ID from the list below to change it — this field is plain text and does not validate against the list.

courses.title: Wash Courses (auto-populated)
courses.description: Auto-populated from the washer's own model data on plugin startup. Each course lists its parameters; edit a parameter's Value to override what Remote Start sends for that course. Values are stored as text; number/boolean parameters are converted back automatically when Start is sent.

allowFilterReset.title: Allow Filter Reset (AC)
allowFilterReset.description: Turning this on lets Apple Home send a real filter-counter reset command to the physical air conditioner, after you've replaced/cleaned the filter. Off by default. This command has not been live-tested yet — enable only when you are ready to verify it yourself.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Pre-issued ThinQ refresh token, used instead of username/password.

debug.title: Enable Debug Mode
debug.description: Enable the debug for the plugin (development only)

clearStorageOnStartup.title: Clear Storage On Startup
clearStorageOnStartup.description: Clear persistence storage and re-initialize the plugin on next startup.

forceAuthentication.title: Force Authentication
forceAuthentication.description: Ignore any cached/saved login session and always authenticate fresh on every start.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)

overrideMatterConfiguration.title: Override Matter Configuration
overrideMatterConfiguration.description: Override the Matter vendor/product identity (vendor name, vendor id, product name, product id) shown for AC devices in Apple Home / any Matter controller.
